fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (contradiction on web-api-read-only): The acceptance has a test 'walk the api registry asserting every allowlisted operation is a read', but the registry has no read marker. Operation.Write (internal/api/api.go) only records whether an operation appends to the log. daemon.set, daemon.start, render and ship.merge all have Write false yet write config, files or GitHub, so a Write-based assertion would pass for them. The leaf needs to name what makes an operation a read (an explicit allowlist checked against a named set, or a new registry flag) so the check can actually fail. The critic confirmed it: internal/api Operation has no read marker: Write only means 'appends to the log', and daemon.set, daemon.start, render and ship.merge all leave Write false while writing git config, files or GitHub. The acceptance's 'every allowlisted operation is a read' has no defined test, so a Write-based check would pass for those writes; the leaf must name what makes an operation a read. How should it be settled?
